prompt: i have just got a new puppy. how should i train it to walk on a leash? give me step by step instructions
response: Introduce the leash by letting your puppy drag it around freely without any attachment. Once your puppy is comfortable, attach the collar and leash and let them get used to it indoors. Start walking your puppy, allowing them to lead and explore at their own pace. Praise them for following you, but don't worry about pulling or stopping. They will learn to walk properly on their own with time.
